text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $82.6k with modest upside, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 4.8% gain, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominance at 59.3%. The Fear & Greed index at 63 (Greed) and climbing over the past week indicates market participants are growing more confident, though not euphoric. Total 24-hour volume of $75.6 trillion reflects sustained participation, pointing to a cautiously optimistic sentiment where traders are rotating into higher-beta assets.
